about: Chat 9 round SB3 (Oct 29 ~11:10 AM): follow-ups from SB2: layer ids / fields / counts / terms for the services SB2's server walks found (ND DMR parks, forests, WMAs; BLM UT rec areas; BLM WY recreation areas, features, scenic backways; Alaska DNR park boundaries; Idaho Parks parks + facilities; LDWF access points + boat launches; MARIS recreation facilities layer ids), + 9.5 parking search for the states with NO access file at all (SD, HI, DC, MS). No keyed calls. Results: roundSB3-tested.json.
